title: Build the visibility adjacency matrix
written_solution: Sort the objects from left to right by center of mass. Output an N×N matrix for the N objects: diagonal cells show the object colors, and an off-diagonal cell is cyan(8) exactly when the two corresponding objects have unobstructed line-of-sight along a row or column.
program_solution:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define objs (objects g 0))
    (define (cell-in? p obj) (member p (obj-cells obj)))
    (define (clear-row? r c1 c2 a b)
      (all? (lambda (c)
              (let ((p (list r c)))
                (or (cell-in? p a) (cell-in? p b) (= (at g r c) 0))))
            (range (min c1 c2) (+ (max c1 c2) 1))))
    (define (clear-col? c r1 r2 a b)
      (all? (lambda (r)
              (let ((p (list r c)))
                (or (cell-in? p a) (cell-in? p b) (= (at g r c) 0))))
            (range (min r1 r2) (+ (max r1 r2) 1))))
    (define (visible? a b)
      (any? (lambda (pa)
              (any? (lambda (pb)
                      (or (and (= (first pa) (first pb))
                               (clear-row? (first pa) (second pa) (second pb) a b))
                          (and (= (second pa) (second pb))
                               (clear-col? (second pa) (first pa) (first pb) a b))))
                    (obj-cells b)))
            (obj-cells a)))
    (define (sum-cols obj) (apply + (map second (obj-cells obj))))
    (define (sum-rows obj) (apply + (map first (obj-cells obj))))
    (define (before? a b)
      (let ((lhs (* (sum-cols a) (obj-size b)))
            (rhs (* (sum-cols b) (obj-size a))))
        (if (= lhs rhs)
            (< (* (sum-rows a) (obj-size b)) (* (sum-rows b) (obj-size a)))
            (< lhs rhs))))
    (define ordered
      (sort objs before?))
    (define n (length ordered))
    (grid-from-fn n n
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((a (list-ref ordered r)) (b (list-ref ordered c)))
          (if (= r c)
              (obj-color a)
              (if (visible? a b) 8 0)))))))
